title: Insights into the mechanisms of neuron generation and specification in the zebrafish ventral spinal cord.
authors: Cucun, Gokhan; Kohler, Melina; Pfitsch, Sabrina; Rastegar, Sepand
one_liner_zh: 该文综述斑马鱼脊髓神经元生成与分化的信号通路和转录因子，属于发育神经生物学，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The vertebrate nervous system is composed of a wide range of neurons and complex synaptic connections, raising the intriguing question of how neuronal diversity is generated. The spinal cord provides an excellent model for exploring the mechanisms governing neuronal diversity due to its simple neural network and the conserved molecular processes involved in neuron formation and specification during evolution. This review specifically examines two distinct progenitor domains present in the zebrafish ventral spinal cord: the lateral floor plate (LFP) and the p2 progenitor domain. The LFP is responsible for the production of GABAergic Kolmer-Agduhr neurons (KA''), glutamatergic V3 neurons, and intraspinal serotonergic neurons, while the p2 domain generates V2 precursors that subsequently differentiate into three unique subpopulations of V2 neurons, namely glutamatergic V2a, GABAergic V2b, and glycinergic V2s. Based on recent findings, we will examine the fundamental signaling pathways and transcription factors that play a key role in the specification of these diverse neurons and neuronal subtypes derived from the LFP and p2 progenitor domains.
abstract_zh: 脊椎动物神经系统由多种神经元和复杂的突触连接组成，这引发了关于神经元多样性如何产生的有趣问题。脊髓因其简单的神经网络以及在进化过程中神经元形成和特化所涉及的保守分子过程，为探索调控神经元多样性的机制提供了极佳模型。本综述特别关注斑马鱼腹侧脊髓中存在的两个不同的祖细胞区域：侧底板（LFP）和p2祖细胞区域。LFP负责产生GABA能Kolmer-Agduhr神经元（KA''）、谷氨酸能V3神经元和脊髓内血清素能神经元，而p2区域则生成V2前体细胞，这些前体随后分化为三种独特的V2神经元亚群，即谷氨酸能V2a、GABA能V2b和甘氨酸能V2s。基于最新发现，我们将探讨在LFP和p2祖细胞区域衍生的这些多样神经元及其亚型特化中起关键作用的基本信号通路和转录因子。
